crossRefs.note: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.
A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

parallels.note: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

people.name: James
people.line: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles

translations.web: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
translations.bsb: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
translations.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
translations.asv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be moved with indignation concerning James and John.
